findings.issue: Failure to report all lending done through DLAs and/or DLAs of LSPs to CICs, including small, short-term deferred payments.
findings.doc_evidence: Because these are small, short-term deferred payments, Coastal Finance does not report them to credit information companies. Only loans above ₹25,000 or longer than 6 months are reported.

findings.issue: Charging fees not mentioned in the KFS without explicit consent of the borrower.
findings.doc_evidence: ShopEase later plans to add a monthly 'account maintenance fee' of ₹49 for active users; this is not in the KFS and will be added to the bill automatically.

findings.issue: Use of misleading or deceptive language in marketing, including claiming RBI approval for a DLG arrangement.
findings.doc_evidence: App store listing and ads say: 'ShopEase PayLater: an RBI-approved credit app.'

findings.issue: Sharing of borrower data with advertising partners without explicit consent, which may violate outsourcing guidelines and CIC reporting requirements.
findings.doc_evidence: Purchase and repayment history is shared with ShopEase's advertising partners to show personalised offers. Users are not asked separately; this is covered by accepting the app's terms of use.

findings.issue: Failure to disclose a one-time processing fee for exiting the loan during the cooling-off period, if applicable.
findings.doc_evidence: Shoppers who change their mind can cancel within 2 days of purchase by paying back the principal with no extra charge.
